The Challenge of the Climb

4.2 KM.250 Meters Up.Every Second Counts.

Set in the mountains of Taif, the Saudi Toyota Championship Hill Climb challenges drivers to master a demanding 4.2 km course, climbing from 1,900 to 2,150 meters above sea level. With technical corners and high speed sections, every turn tests precision, control, and nerve.
